messages:
sasha: FYI customer (AcmeHealth) upgraded to redwood-python 1.10.0 and started seeing immediate errors.

sasha: Error shows: TypeError: Client.__init__() got an unexpected keyword argument 'retry_policy'

maya: ouch. Do we rename param in 1.10? @kevin_platform any change in signature?

kevin_platform: yep, during API cleanup we switched to 'retries' (int) instead of 'retry_policy' (object) in 1.10.0, but forgot compat shim. Bug.

jun_engineer: reproducing locally now. quick repro:
```python
from redwood import Client
Client(api_key='x', retry_policy={'max_attempts':3})
```
This fails in 1.10.0, works in 1.9.3

sasha: customer uses a wrapper that still passes retry_policy via kwargs. They saw it in prod after an automated dependency update :grimacing:

maya: temporary mitigation: pin to 1.9.3 in their requirements.txt or change callsites to `retries=`. e.g.
```
# requirements.txt
redwood==1.9.3
```
or
```py
Client(api_key=..., retries=3)
```

kevin_platform: created a patch branch with a compatibility shim; planning to release 1.10.1 shortly. For now internal note: add release note and deprecation warning for 1.11

ops-bot: deploy job started for patch branch redwood/compat/retry-shim -> staging

sasha: shared workaround with customer and requested permission to pin. They want an ETA. What's ETA?

kevin_platform: aiming for 1.10.1 within 4 hours if tests pass. Will post the release changelog.

maya: thanks. I'll mark the ticket as escalated -> engineering and advise pin.

jun_engineer: just pushed unit tests for shim, all green locally.

kevin_platform: release done 1.10.1 — includes shim and logs a deprecation warning when 'retry_policy' is used. Posting changelog: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.10.1

sasha: customer pinned and verified, error cleared. closing the escalation :white_check_mark:

maya: please update notes in support runbook about pinning strategy and automated dependency updates.

kevin_platform: added note in PR to docs; will add a short blurb to the upgrade guide.

sasha: thanks everyone :tada:
